pairs._source: plan rev3 A5, our choice: within the 30-site subset (10 tag-nearest triples) every other subset site is an O (30 x 29 = 870 pairs); tier from the O's tag-distance rank to KB among the 29: near 1-2 (mostly the KB's own triple), mid 3-10, far 11-29. All other rules (bands, fixed members, slots, scores, metrics) identical to A1; comparison sites are restricted to the subset because Qwen3 banks exist only there

comparison.fixed_rule: far band (d > q_far) to both O and KB, category != category(O)
comparison._source: plan rev3 A1: m = 4, R = 5; slot roles O (leak), N1/N2 (two nearest eligible to O outside KB's neighbour band), M (median rank to O), Z1/Z2 (random, far band to both), Zm (sensitivity, user decision 2026-10-06: far band to O, KB-distance rank closest to N1's), K (nearest eligible to KB outside O's neighbour band and not N1/N2), NK (min rank_O + rank_KB among eligible not already used). Eligible = not KB, not O, not a fixed member

scores._source: plan sec.2 (D6 tau sweep; FLatS alpha grid); cosine top-10 mean (abs, S_tau, mix) and 10th-NN (absk, mixk)

metrics._source: analysis rev3 sec.5: d' primary (all pairs), G secondary on A_abs <= 0.98; operating point = threshold accepting 95% of the KB calibration queries; two-way (KB x O) bootstrap
metrics._dprime_clip_source: our choice (as P19): AUROC clipped to [1e-4, 1 - 1e-4] before Phi^-1

_a5_source: A5 (generality): A1 rerun on the subset for bge-m3, contriever-msmarco and Qwen3 (same sites, same planning for all three); sign agreement of the key results is read across the three (analysis rev3 sec.3)
_cluster_source: A5 review 2026-10-06: the subset is 10 tag-nearest triples, so sites are not independent; a two-way triple-level bootstrap (KB-triples x O-triples) is reported as a sensitivity next to the site-level two-way interval
